name: architecture
default_or_baseline: Vanadis multi-core + per-core RoCC + per-core GlobalMemory + Mesh NoC
description: Control plane via ctrl link + request scheduler, data plane via GM/NoC/DMA

name: grouping
description: Manager cores on first row, workers connected by slot-based req/rsp links

name: mvm.s
description: Store output vector to main memory (rs1=dst_addr, rs2=array_id)

name: mvm.mv
description: Move array output to another array input (rs1=src_array, rs2=dst_array)

name: mvm.ovec2gm
description: Store array output vector to local GlobalMemory (rs1=gm_addr, rs2=array_id)

name: mvm.gm2ivec
description: Load local GlobalMemory vector into array input (rs1=gm_addr, rs2=array_id)

name: mvm.gm2imat
description: Load local GlobalMemory matrix into array input (rs1=gm_addr, rs2=array_id)

name: remote.st
description: Remote store: local GM to remote GM (rs1=local_gm, rs2=remote_gm)

name: remote.ld
description: Remote load: remote GM to local GM (rs1=remote_gm, rs2=local_gm)

name: mm2gm
description: DMA main memory to GlobalMemory (rs1=mm_addr, rs2=gm_addr)

name: gm2mm
description: DMA GlobalMemory to main memory (rs1=mm_addr, rs2=gm_addr)

name: reg2gm
description: Write register scalar to GlobalMemory (rs1=value, rs2=gm_addr)

name: gm2reg
description: Read GlobalMemory scalar to register (rs1=gm_addr, rd=result)

name: GOLEM_ROCC_TYPE
description: RoCC type (auto-switch to float type when dtype=fp32)

name: GOLEM_ARRAY_TYPE
description: Array type (auto-switch to float type when dtype=fp32)

name: GOLEM_ARRAY_MAC_PER_CU_PER_CYCLE
description: MAC throughput per CU per cycle

name: GOLEM_MATMUL_DTYPE
description: Matmul dtype baseline in run preset

name: GOLEM_GLOBAL_STRIDE_KB
description: Per-core GlobalMemory window size in KB

name: GOLEM_IDENTITY_BASE
description: Identity window base for host-memory split

name: GOLEM_CTRL_OVERLAP_AB
description: A/B overlap baseline in DMA preset
